about: Against the computer the board's layout box sits between its two player bars (gaps >= 0) and no piece's painted box (each drawn at scale 1.06) crosses into either bar, at move 0 and after 4 plies, at 375x568 (the job's size), 320x568 and 375x761 with his insets. Graded by gate 208 (TC-R328..329). The job's overlap was NOT reproduced on 3b8ef29f (gap 2px under the board; the pieces paint 1.3px past it), as #550 found; the gate keeps that measurement. NOT COVERED: his phone (iOS Safari), which is where a picture of an overlap would come from.
